text: Long coffee with Kavya. Her knee op is finally booked for next Tuesday and she's dreading the anaesthetic. Her husband Reza is taking the week off to look after her. Their son Kai is home from uni that week too, so she'll have plenty of help. She's also been reading loads, mostly crime novels, which is handy because her birthday's early December. I should text her Monday night.

Chen's back from Seoul, says the flight was fourteen hours and he barely slept. He's already planning Japan with his sister Aditi early March. Into film cameras at the moment, keeps showing me photos.
Felix turns 40 end of the month. Ava says he's been dropping hints about a proper espresso machine. She's organising drinks Saturday the 31st, I'm doing the cake.
Phoebe's mum had her hip replaced on Thursday. Phoebe sounded shattered, she's been at the hospital every evening. Need to drop round some food for her this weekend.
Caught Mehmet outside the station. He and Irina are off to Cappadocia in a fortnight for their anniversary. Hot air balloon at sunrise, apparently Irina's terrified of heights.
Anika's surgery got cancelled again, third time now. She's fed up and still in pain most days. Ring her tomorrow.
Samir mentioned his dad's cataract appointment is sometime next week. Ethan's driving them both. Samir's been really into bouldering lately, goes three nights a week.
Juan loves anything to do with F1, worth remembering for his birthday in June.
Svetlana got back from her scan Friday, all clear! She was in tears telling me. Her partner Andile booked them a weekend in Lisbon to celebrate, leaving next Thursday. Must send her flowers.

Andre and Chloe have the long-haul to Auckland on the 14th, visiting her grandparents. Chloe hates flying, she's already stressing about the layover in Singapore. Andre says she's taking sleeping tablets. I said I'd water their plants while they're away. They're back on the 2nd, and Andre has a physio appointment that same afternoon for his back, which he keeps putting off.
Simone's back at work Monday after the gallbladder thing. Says she's fine but she looked tired. Check on her midweek.
Pick up Aisha's present before Friday - she's mad about Studio Ghibli, the Totoro lamp from that shop on King St.
Kiri broke her wrist at netball on Sunday. Cast for six weeks, can't drive. Her brother Kai is ferrying her about. She's annoyed she'll miss the tournament end of November.
Nina had her wisdom teeth out yesterday, face like a hamster. Her flatmate Shreya says she's surviving on soup and Netflix.
Dentist 9am tomorrow, then pharmacy. Don't forget the passport photos.

Angela's planning a big surprise for Siddharth's 50th sometime in early December. She wants everyone to chip in for a weekend at a spa hotel. Siddharth's into whisky too, so maybe a tasting voucher as a backup. Remind me to transfer her the money by Friday.
Nikolai flies to Toronto next Wednesday for three months, work secondment. His wife Hadiza and the kids follow over Christmas. He's nervous about the cold, ha.
Saw Aidan at the school gates. His little girl's having grommets put in on the 3rd, first general anaesthetic, he's a wreck about it. Sana's going in with her. Text Aidan that morning.
Aurelio's grandmother died last week, the funeral is in Naples on Saturday. He's flying out Thursday with his mum. Really quiet when I saw him. I need to send a card before he goes.
Kavya says Reza's birthday is the 9th and he's obsessed with sourdough at the moment. Banneton and a fancy lame would go down well.
Chen's dog Biscuit had his leg operation this morning. Chen says the vet's pleased. Biscuit has to wear the cone for ten days.

Talked to Aditi on the phone for ages. Her dad is in for a bypass sometime next week, they don't have the exact date yet. She's flying back from Dubai on Sunday to be with her mum. She's trying to hold it together. Her brother Felix Khan can't get time off, which she's annoyed about. I should call her once she's landed, and maybe offer to pick her up from Heathrow.
Ava's into pottery now, takes a class Tuesday nights. Doesn't drink coffee anymore, only matcha.
Phoebe and her husband are finally doing the Iceland trip over the summer. She asked if I'd look after their cat Pickle for the week.

Mehmet said Irina's ankle surgery went well on Monday. She's on crutches for a month and going stir crazy. Her sister Nina is coming over from Bucharest for a week to help out. Mehmet's cooking every night and says he's running out of recipes. Ask her how the physio goes next Thursday.
Irina mentioned Mehmet's birthday is this weekend. He wants new running shoes but won't buy them himself. Hint hint.
Quick catch-up with Anika and Samir at lunch. Anika's daughter starts nursery after half term. Samir's off to Marrakech end of the month with his boyfriend. Both seem good.
Ethan's sister Chloe had a baby girl on Wednesday! Ethan's an uncle now and hasn't stopped smiling. Baby's called Rosa. Must get a card for Chloe.
Juan's in hospital since Saturday with appendicitis, op went ok. Should be out tomorrow or Thursday. His girlfriend Svetlana is staying with him. I'll visit at the weekend if he's home.
Svetlana told me Juan's actually a huge Lego nerd. Christmas idea.
Andile's flying to Cape Town next Friday for his brother's wedding. He's best man and hasn't written the speech yet, panicking a bit. Wish him luck before he goes.
Andre had his MRI this morning, results in about two weeks. Back's been bad for months and he can barely sit at his desk. Should check in with him end of next week.

Lovely evening with Simone and Aisha. Simone's daughter is doing her Grade 5 piano exam on the 22nd. Aisha's just back from Peru, did the Inca Trail and loved it, but got altitude sickness on day two. She's already eyeing Patagonia for next year. Simone says the fondue night is moving to her place, Friday after next.
Kiri's birthday is on Saturday. She keeps going on about a Kindle. Get one before Thursday so it arrives.
Nina said Shreya's interview for the hospital job is next Monday. She's nervous, it's her dream role. Text Shreya Sunday night.
Book flights for Lisbon before prices go up. Also renew travel insurance by end of the month.

Angela's mum fell and broke her hip last week, now in hospital awaiting surgery. Angela is travelling up and down every day and looks exhausted. Siddharth is doing all the school runs. Their eldest, Aidan, has his football tournament this weekend and nobody can take him. Offer to have their boys Saturday, and maybe ask Angela if she wants a lift to the hospital on Tuesday.
Kai's back from his trip to Vietnam. Three weeks backpacking, came back with a ridiculous tan and a lot of opinions about pho. He's started learning Vietnamese on Duolingo.
Nikolai's mother has her cataract op tomorrow at 2. He's taking her and staying the night at hers.
Hadiza is expecting again! Due in April. Morning sickness has been awful though. She and Nikolai haven't told his family yet. Congratulate her properly when I see her next week.
Aidan said Sana's surgery has been postponed to early January. Not ideal, she's in a lot of pain still. Should take her for lunch sometime next week.
Aurelio got back from Italy last night. He said the funeral was hard but good to be with family. Check in on him over the weekend.

Kavya's knee op went fine on Tuesday. She's home, bored, binge-watching Bake Off. Reza says she's not allowed to bend it for two weeks. Her mum is flying in from Chennai sometime next week to stay for a month, which Reza is pretending to be thrilled about. Pop round with brownies Thursday.
Chen loves board games, especially anything with trains. His birthday's 2nd Nov.

Long call with Felix. He's been offered a job in Singapore and moves out in the new year. Ava's going with him obviously. They're doing a leaving do sometime mid December. He's buzzing but she's a bit anxious about leaving her mum, who's had a few health scares this year. I should help them sell the sofa, and don't forget to ask Ava how her mum's appointment goes on Friday.
Phoebe mentioned her son Ethan's tonsils are coming out next Monday. He's only six and very brave about it apparently.
Mehmet - big Galatasaray fan, hates mushrooms, allergic to cats.
Anika's in Mumbai for her cousin's wedding all of next week. Back on the 12th. Her husband Reza Garcia stayed home with the dog.
Samir's mum has her follow-up with the consultant on Wednesday. He's going with her. Message Samir after to see what they said.
Garden centre Saturday, then haircut. Need to sort the boiler service before winter.

Svetlana's 30th is in a fortnight. Andile's planning a weekend in Prague as a surprise, flying out Friday the 7th. He wants me to help pack her bag secretly. She's mentioned wanting a film camera, so I could get her one from all of us.
Juan's home and recovering, said the op scar is healing nicely. He's going back to work part-time next week. Text him Monday to see how the first day goes.
Andre and Chloe got back from New Zealand Tuesday. Chloe survived the flights. They're both jet lagged and Andre's back flared up on the plane. He sees the physio tomorrow.
Simone's daughter passed her Grade 5 with distinction! Simone is so proud. Send them a card.
Aisha's mum, Mrs Khan, is having her other knee done in the spring. Aisha's dreading it after the first one went so badly. Remember to ask about dates.
Kiri and her husband Kai have their tenth anniversary on Sunday. Off to the Lakes for the weekend. She loves anything Japanese, wears that kimono jacket constantly.

Nina, Shreya and Angela at the pub tonight. Shreya got the hospital job! Starts after Christmas. Nina's thinking about Thailand early February, wants me to come. Angela's mum is out of hospital and staying with them for now, which is a lot. Shreya's birthday drinks are next Friday, I'm bringing the prosecco.
Siddharth's into gin now as well as whisky. Collects those little miniature bottles.
Hadiza had her 12 week scan yesterday, all fine. She's feeling a bit better.
Was going to Aidan's barbecue tomorrow but it's off because of the weather. Sana's still in pain, so maybe just as well. Drop her a message later.
